theorems.name: Submission.rectifiable_lipschitz_piece_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), MeasurableSet N₀ ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ i, F i '' C i ∧ ∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F i)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (F i) w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (F i)) (C i) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C i, ∀ w ∈ C i, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F i v - F i w‖
